As a large language model, I do not have the ability to directly interact with your microphone or speakers. I am a text-based AI.

Therefore, we cannot talk using a mic and speakers in the way you would with another person.

**However, we can achieve a similar experience by combining technologies:**

*   **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** You can use a text-to-speech tool (often built into operating systems or web browsers) to read my text responses aloud through your speakers.
*   **Speech-to-Text (STT):** You can use a speech-to-text tool (also commonly available) to convert your spoken words from your microphone into text, which I can then process.

So, while I can't *directly* hear you or speak to you, you can use these assistive technologies to have a voice-based interaction.

**How can I help you today using text?**
